title: Counit-normalized local section comparison formulas
statement: For ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use the canonical section/fibre arrows [def-pur-noetherian-section-specialization-arrows], exact inverse images [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], the finite Tate sheaves and their root-normalized pullback [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. For a finite commutative ring A killed by N>0 and N invertible on a Noetherian T, set T_d=A_T(d)[2d]. The affine right functor is p^*(-) tensor A(d), shifted by 2d [cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction]. Given its adjunction, define the dualizing comparison by the unique right-adjoint isomorphism respecting counits, then the coefficient-unit and tensor-unit isomorphisms; pull to a section and use Tate pullback. Define section locality by the unique counit-compatible isomorphism [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality], with inverse-image compositors. The chart map is inverse section locality followed by the affine section comparison. For C on T, F on A1_T, c:C~T_d, f:F~T_d over A1_T, define lambda=f; tau^{-1}; a*(c^{-1}). For theta:i1*F~C, define restriction using the canonical i1*a*~id compositor, h=theta^{-1}; restriction(lambda), and lambda_norm=lambda; a*(h^{-1}). Also define the local restriction of the actual at-one counit arrow along any base map using the commuting one-section square. These are actual formulas, with no arbitrary fibre identification. Unit preservation and Noetherian finite-type permanence are the elementary well-definedness obligations for these formulas.
